title: Invocation Context Harmonizer and Alert Suppressor
author: Aisha Patel
description:
Motivation: noisy alert fatigue from long-running conversational sessions and duplicated context logs has obscured real regressions. This PR introduces two coordinated features: a lightweight Invocation Context Harmonizer that consolidates related traces/metrics into a single canonical invocation record, and an Alert Suppressor (noise-gate) that reduces alert churn by suppressing low-confidence SLO breaches that are attributable to expected context-reassembly behavior.

What this changes (high level):
- Harmonizer: canonicalizes invocation identifiers when requests are part of the same user session (heuristics: session cookie, model version, and contiguous timestamp bounds). It stitches partial KV-cache-prefetch traces and merges duplicate span edges so dashboards show a single invocation timeline instead of fragmented microtraces.
- Suppressor: adds an alert-preprocess step that tags potential context-reassembly incidents and applies an adaptive suppression window. Suppressed alerts are still recorded for offline analysis and surfaced in a new "suppressed_alerts" dashboard panel.

Implementation notes:
- New components live in telemetry/service: ContextHarmonizer (go) and AlertGate (go). A small shim in the tracing collector (collector/harmonizer_shim.go) enriches spans with harmonizer_id.
- Harmonizer emits two new metrics: telemetry.harmonizer.stitch_count and telemetry.harmonizer.stitch_latency_ms. Both exported with per-tenant labels and invocation_cohort.
- AlertGate implements a tunable policy table (yaml) stored in config/observability/alert_gate.yaml with defaults that favor short suppression windows for paid tiers.
- Backwards compatible: if the collector shim is disabled, the Harmonizer becomes a no-op and all existing metrics/traces flow unchanged.

Checklist: 
- [x] Unit tests for shim and harmonizer heuristics
- [x] End-to-end replay with synthetic sessions (replaybench)
- [x] Integration in console: new suppressed_alerts panel + harmonizer sparkline
- [x] Feature flag gated (operator flag: enable_context_harmonizer)

Files changed (high level):
- telemetry/service/context_harmonizer.go
- telemetry/service/alert_gate.go
- collector/harmonizer_shim.go
- config/observability/alert_gate.yaml (defaults)
- console/dashboards/suppressed_alerts.json
- console/widgets/harmonizer_sparkline.tsx
- replaybench/sessions/sample_replay.json
- docs/observability/context_harmonizer.md
- tests/integration/harmonizer_replay_test.go

Runtime and perf considerations: 
- Harmonizer performs a small in-memory session coalescing window (default 2s) per request route. We added lightweight LRU eviction to bound memory. Benchmarks included in the PR show <1% tail latency impact for p95 on a 2000rps synthetic load with shard-local processing.

Review notes and known tradeoffs: 
- Heuristic vs deterministic linking: we intentionally kept heuristics simple to avoid cross-service coordination during rollout. Future work is to offer an opt-in deterministic session token propagated by SDKs.
- Suppression policy tuning is conservative by default to avoid hiding real regressions. Ops can customize via alert_gate.yaml.

Release notes: 
- Introduces Invocation Context Harmonizer (optional operator flag) to reduce fragmentation in invocation traces and metrics.
- Adds Alert Suppressor to reduce alert noise from expected context-reassembly; suppressed alerts appear in a dedicated console panel for investigation.

How to test: 
- Enable feature via operator config and run replaybench with replaybench/sessions/sample_replay.json. Verify that fragmented spans are merged (single harmonizer_id) and that suppressed alerts appear in console but do not trigger on-call notifications for the configured window.

Related work: ENG-3121 (sessionized-traces), ENG-3319 (alert-smoothing prototype).

release_notes: Optional feature-flagged Invocation Context Harmonizer to consolidate fragmented traces and an Alert Suppressor (noise-gate) to reduce non-actionable SLO alerts. Includes console panels for suppressed alerts and harmonizer metrics.
notes_for_oncall: If SLO alerts appear quieter during rollout, check console:suppressed_alerts for suppressed events and verify alert_gate policy. If missing harmonizer_id on spans, ensure collector operator flag enable_context_harmonizer is set and collector version >= 1.32.0.
